discovery.measurement: Authored tool-description ranking only, 32 candidates maximum, no agent execution, cold application cache. Recall at five and empty results for absent capabilities. No agent-token savings, end-to-end latency improvement or general accuracy claim.
discovery.comparison: The same authored queries and fixed promotion threshold were used before and after adding the local-page bypass. The two runs were sequential, not interleaved; remote service latency is uncontrolled. Skipped requests have known zero API input usage. This measures avoided Jev calls, not downstream agent savings.
